description: This Java source file defines the 'ICalWorker' class, which handles WebDAV requests related to iCalendar data within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for handling GET, PUT, PROPFIND requests, and manages calendar data conversion, response creation, and user authentication.

classes.name: ICalWorker
classes.description: A utility class that handles WebDAV requests for iCalendar data, including GET, PUT, and PROPFIND operations, within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ICalWorker.ResponseProperties
classes.description: A nested class encapsulating HTTP response status code and message for WebDAV communication.

methods.name: createConversionContext
methods.description: Creates a context map for calendar data conversion based on the HTTP request attributes and parameters.

methods.name: createForbiddenResponse
methods.description: Constructs a ResponseProperties object representing an HTTP 403 Forbidden response.

methods.name: createNotAuthorizedResponse
methods.description: Constructs a ResponseProperties object representing an HTTP 401 Unauthorized response.

methods.name: createNotFoundResponse
methods.description: Constructs a ResponseProperties object representing an HTTP 404 Not Found response.

methods.name: createOkResponse
methods.description: Constructs a ResponseProperties object representing an HTTP 200 OK response.

methods.name: createPartialContentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a ResponseProperties object for an HTTP 206 Partial Content response, indicating partial calendar updates.

methods.name: getLastModifiedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last modified timestamp of the calendar data associated with a specific work effort.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Processes a GET request to retrieve the iCalendar data for a specific work effort, responding with the calendar content.

methods.name: handlePropFindRequest
methods.description: Handles a PROPFIND WebDAV request, returning properties such as getetag and getlastmodified related to the calendar resource.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Handles a PUT request to update or store iCalendar data for a specific work effort.

methods.name: isValidRequest
methods.description: Validates incoming requests for proper security and required attributes before processing.

methods.name: logInUser
methods.description: Performs user login operations based on credentials extracted from the request.

methods.name: setupRequest
methods.description: Sets up request attributes, including extracting the work effort ID and completing user login.

methods.name: writeResponse
methods.description: Writes the ResponseProperties' status and message into the HttpServletResponse.
